title: Разрушитель галактики
alt: Beng Huai Xinghe 崩坏星河
description: In the early stages of the Sirius War, a newcomer to the battlefield provided his worth as a new generation of super soldiers through several heroic battlers on the front lines. However, just as he was advancing triumphantly with his superior, he was ambushed by the Black Army of Ge Kai. His superior was killed, thus the battlefield was lost, and he was then forced to retreat. The rear base was deserted, but a familiar figure was found—a comrade from the previous battle. He was just an ordinary man, and was presumed to be dead by the Black Army's ambush, however was instead found unharmed. When greeted, the man was unresponsive, and because of the ambush suspicion grew that the man was colluding with the Black Army, so he was secretly investigated and discovered that his background was very mysterious, and all that was found was that he called himself Wang Ye. (Source: Kaca Entertainment, translated, edited)
